title_zh: 暂停手册印刷并修正索引错页

scenario.label_zh: 核对手册索引的印刷错误
scenario.goal_zh: 确认索引页码错误并暂停印刷，约定修改后由另一人逐项核对再开印

context_zh: 同事检查即将批量印刷的志愿者手册样张。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: The index sends readers to page twelve for emergency contacts, but they're on page fourteen.

sentences.speaker: Nathan
sentences.text: You're right. Those page numbers are incorrect. We added two pages after making the index.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Has the full print run started?

sentences.speaker: Nathan
sentences.text: No, this is just the proof. The ink is still wet on the test sheet.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Please hold the rest. I'll update the references in the file.

sentences.speaker: Nathan
sentences.text: And I'll check each entry against the new proof before we print any more.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Good. Let's leave the printer paused until we've both signed off on that version.

targets.sense_zh: 书末按主题列出的索引
